name: ScoreHub - Game Score Tracker
tagline: Track your board game scores easily
blurb: ScoreHub is a simple and intuitive application for tracking game scores across multiple players.
description:
ScoreHub is a simple and intuitive application for tracking game scores across multiple players.

Features:
• Multi-game support
• Player management with custom colors
• Comprehensive statistics and rankings
• Top 20 high scores leaderboard
• Win/loss/draw tracking
• Multi-language support
• Fully offline

Perfect for board game enthusiasts who want to keep detailed records of their gaming sessions!

Currently supported games:
- Akropolis
- Belote
- Cactus
- Cribbage
- Escoba
- Farkle
- Flip7
- Harmonies
- Ligretto
- Oh Hell
- Qwixx
- Skyjo
- Tarot
- Ticket to ride
- Wingspan
- Yahtzee

- Free Game
